clips.title: The story
paras: At the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, Dawnwatcher Selgorm watches for threats across northern Kalimdor. The human serves the Argent Dawn as an observer and liaison in the night elven capital, tracking reports of shadowy cult activity and dark powers stirring nearby.

Dawnwatcher Selgorm keeps watch in Darnassus for the Argent Dawn. The order's fight against the undead Scourge in the Eastern Plaguelands does not end its vigilance elsewhere. From the Craftsmen's Terrace, Selgorm gathers reports of emerging threats in Kalimdor's wilds. He connects the night elves with the wider effort against ancient evil and seeks Alliance travelers able to strike at cultists and dark powers before their influence spreads.
